We are pleased to hear that you found the service reasonable when attending the practice in person. We are sorry, however, for the frustration caused by long waiting times on the phone. We understand how inconvenient this can be, particularly when callers are placed in a queue.

At busy times our phone lines can become extremely congested due to high demand, and our reception team works hard to answer calls as quickly as possible while also assisting patients at the desk and managing urgent clinical requests. The queue message is intended to keep callers informed rather than leave calls unanswered, but we recognise that waiting on hold can be costly and frustrating.

We are actively reviewing our telephone system and call-handling processes to see how we can improve access and reduce waiting times. We would also encourage patients, where possible, to use our online services for appointment requests, prescription queries and non-urgent matters.

Thank you again for your feedback — it helps us identify areas where we can improve our service.
